items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I've heard of him, I never knew him.

ctx.x: Did you ever play at the Tuxedo Brass Band? Not in them days, no. Or the Onward Brass Band, Emmanuel Perez, ever? No, I didn't play with them. I might ask, we only have another minute or so on this tape, but who were your favorite trombonists? You mentioned Frankie Doosan, and any others that you liked real well?

Yeah, I got a couple of young fellas under them, a little fella by the name of Moise French, used to play with Rene. I've heard of him, I never knew him. Yeah, I find he was a sweet little trombone player. We had another little fella that you played some nice trombone. He used to play with a little fella that's called Clayton. I forget that boy name. Did you ever interview Clayton? No, not yet. We'll do that pretty soon. Yeah, well. I know him very well.
